_comment: Per-soldier multi-target melee (#1092): SoldierMelee.resolve now searches every attacking soldier's nearest enemy across EVERY adjacent engaged enemy unit, not just whichever one target_enemy resolves to -- so a unit genuinely fighting 2+ distinct adjacent enemies damages all of them in the same cadence, with no rotation needed (retiring #1086's round-robin). One player Infantry regiment (team 0, uid 0, 64 soldiers) spawns closely flanked by two distinct enemy Infantry regiments (team 1, uid 1, 26 soldiers, due south; uid 2, spawn-adjusted to 22 soldiers, east-southeast). At tick 6, before combat fully develops, the player selects the unit and issues Ctrl+F2 (Multiple engage). Verified via dump-state.sh: all three reach FIGHTING by tick 60, target_enemy_uid locks onto uid 2 and never rotates, yet BOTH enemies take casualties across the same window -- uid 1 drops 26 -> 24 and uid 2 drops 22 -> 20 by tick 400 -- instead of only the locked target taking damage. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
